correctness.rationale: The divisor calculation is valid. Over K=Q(sqrt(-2)), D+=X_K cap V(x-a y) is the smooth plane quartic 8y^4-9z^4-36w^4=0 and meets X transversely; x-a y has order one there. The other numerator factor and the denominator are nonzero at an explicit geometric point, so v_D(theta)=1. The tame residue of (theta,-1) is [-1], and -1 is nonsquare in K and hence in the geometrically integral constant-field extension K(D+). Purity therefore excludes the class from Br(X_K), and restriction excludes it from Br(X). The inspected verify.py matches these steps; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
